beginner.summary: For new Salesforce administrators, business analysts and users moving into admin roles. Covers CRM concepts, the Salesforce org, standard and custom objects, the security and sharing model, data management, page layouts, validation, reports and dashboards, Flow, Sales Cloud and Service Cloud processes, and Administrator exam preparation.
prerequisites: Understands basic business processes such as sales and customer support
Comfortable with web applications and spreadsheets
A free Salesforce Developer Edition org
outcomes: Configure a Salesforce org with objects, fields, layouts and apps
Set up users, profiles, permission sets and sharing
Load and manage data and build reports and dashboards
Automate simple processes with Flow and support Sales and Service teams

days.topic: Salesforce and CRM Overview and Org Setup
subtopics: What CRM is and why companies use it
Salesforce clouds: Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience
Signing up for a Developer Edition org
Company information, fiscal year and currencies
days.lab_task: Create a Developer Edition org, set company information, locale, fiscal year and currency, and map the course company's sales and support processes to Salesforce clouds.
checks: Locale, currency and fiscal year set
Each process mapped to a cloud

days.topic: Standard Objects and the Data Model
subtopics: Accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities and cases
Data model for a sales company
days.lab_task: Draw the standard data model for the course company in Schema Builder and create sample accounts, contacts, opportunities and cases linked correctly.
checks: Related contacts, opportunities and cases shown

days.lab_task: Create custom objects for Training Courses and Enrolments with a junction object, formula and roll-up fields, dependent picklists and field history tracking.
checks: Enrol two contacts in a course

days.topic: Page Layouts, Record Types and Lightning App Builder
subtopics: Assigning pages by profile and app
days.lab_task: Build a Lightning app for the training team with custom record pages using dynamic forms, two record types with different layouts and a custom home page.
checks: Open a course with each record type
Fields appear only when conditions are met

days.topic: Users, Profiles, Roles and Permission Sets
subtopics: Permission sets and permission set groups
days.lab_task: Create users for sales reps, a sales manager and a support agent, assign minimal profiles, add permissions with permission sets and build the role hierarchy.
days.deliverable: Users, permission sets and role hierarchy
checks: Log in as a sales rep
Cannot see setup or delete accounts

subtopics: Viewing who can see a record
days.lab_task: Set opportunities to private, share them up the role hierarchy, add a sharing rule for a partner team, hide a commission field and check access for three users.
checks: Open a record as a support agent

days.topic: Data Management: Import, Export and Data Quality
days.lab_task: Import 500 leads and accounts with the wizard and Data Loader, upsert with an external ID, block duplicates with duplicate rules and export a backup.
days.deliverable: Imported data, duplicate rules and backup file

subtopics: Required fields and when to use them
days.lab_task: Write validation rules that require a close reason for lost opportunities, stop backdated close dates and check discount limits by role, and test each.
checks: Mark an opportunity lost without a reason
Save blocked with a clear message
Set a close date in the past
Enter a discount above the limit as a rep
Blocked, but allowed for the manager

subtopics: Tabular, summary, matrix and joined reports
days.lab_task: Build a sales pipeline report, a cases by priority report, a custom report type for enrolments and a dashboard for the sales manager.
checks: Group pipeline by stage and owner
Open the dashboard as a rep
Data shown follows the running user setting

days.topic: Flow Builder Essentials: Screen and Record-Triggered Flows
days.lab_task: Build a record-triggered flow that creates a follow-up task when an opportunity reaches negotiation, and a screen flow that lets agents log a customer complaint.
checks: Case created with the entered details
Path taken shown in debug output

days.lab_task: Build a discount approval process that sends large discounts to the manager, locks the record, emails the rep on approval and sends a custom notification on rejection.
checks: Rep receives an email and the record unlocks

days.topic: Sales Cloud: Leads, Opportunities and Forecasts
days.lab_task: Set up lead assignment rules, a sales process with path guidance, products and price books, quotes and forecasts, then take a lead to a closed-won deal.
checks: Create a web lead from Mumbai
Assigned to the West region queue

days.topic: Service Cloud: Cases, Queues and Knowledge
days.lab_task: Set up email-to-case, assignment and escalation rules, queues, an entitlement with a response milestone, knowledge articles and a Service Console app.
days.deliverable: Service Cloud configuration and test cases
checks: Send an email to the support address
Case created in the right queue
Leave a case past its milestone
Attach a knowledge article to a case

subtopics: Email integration with Outlook and Gmail
days.lab_task: Set up Outlook or Gmail integration, log activities on opportunities, create a Chatter group for a deal team and use the mobile app to update a record.
checks: Log an email from Outlook or Gmail

days.lab_task: Evaluate three AppExchange apps for e-signatures, install one in the org, assign permissions, test it and write a build-or-buy recommendation.
checks: App available to assigned users only

days.lab_task: Build a change in a sandbox, move it to production with a change set after validation and write a release note for users.
days.deliverable: Change set, deployment record and release note

days.lab_task: Build a customer self-service site where customers log in, view their cases, create new ones and search knowledge, with guest access locked down.
checks: Create a case from the site

days.topic: Einstein and AI Features for Admins
subtopics: Einstein features in Sales and Service Cloud
days.lab_task: Turn on Einstein features available in the org, build a Prompt Builder template that drafts a follow-up email from an opportunity and review what data the Trust Layer masks.
days.deliverable: Configuration, prompt template and review notes

subtopics: Object manager and Lightning App Builder
days.lab_task: Take a timed 60-question Administrator practice exam, review every wrong answer with Trailhead and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, review notes and study plan
checks: Each linked to a topic and Trailhead module

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: CRM Implementation for a Training Company
days.lab_task: Implement Salesforce for a training company with leads to deals, courses and enrolments, secure sharing, a data import, flows and approvals, a support process and management dashboards, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Configured org, data load results, dashboards and a 10-minute demo
checks: Take a lead to an enrolment
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one implementation

intermediate.summary: For administrators moving into advanced configuration and development. Covers advanced Flow, Apex, SOQL, triggers and testing, Lightning Web Components, integrations with REST APIs and platform events, security in depth, Salesforce DX and source-driven development, Experience Cloud and Service Cloud in depth, CPQ basics, Agentforce and Platform Developer I preparation.
prerequisites: Holds or is ready for the Administrator certification
Configures objects, security, flows and reports
Basic programming knowledge in any language
outcomes: Build complex automation with Flow and Apex
Use source-driven development and pass Platform Developer I

days.topic: Advanced Flow: Subflows, Loops and Error Handling
days.lab_task: Build a scheduled flow that renews expiring contracts in bulk using subflows, collections and fault paths, and add flow tests.
checks: Fault path logs the error and notifies the admin

subtopics: What Apex is and when to use it
days.lab_task: Write an Apex class that calculates a discount for opportunities based on account tier and updates them in bulk, staying within governor limits.
checks: DML and SOQL counts within limits

subtopics: Relationship queries: parent to child and child to parent
days.lab_task: Write SOQL for accounts with open opportunities and their contacts, aggregate pipeline by owner, search across objects with SOSL and fix a dynamic query open to injection.
checks: Pass an injection string to the dynamic query
Treated as text after the fix

days.lab_task: Write a bulkified trigger with a handler class that keeps account totals in sync with opportunities, prevents recursion and works with a 200-record data load.
days.deliverable: Trigger, handler and data load results
checks: Account totals correct and no limit errors
Update an opportunity twice in one transaction

subtopics: Testing as different users with runAs
The 75 percent coverage rule and real quality
days.lab_task: Write tests for the discount class and trigger covering bulk, negative and user permission cases, mock a callout and reach over 90 percent coverage.
checks: Run as a user without permission

days.lab_task: Write a Batch Apex job that recalculates scores for 100,000 accounts, schedule it nightly and chain a Queueable that sends a summary.
days.deliverable: Batch, Queueable and schedule with monitoring evidence

subtopics: LWC structure: HTML, JavaScript and metadata
days.lab_task: Build an LWC that shows an account's open opportunities with Lightning Data Service and Apex, lets users update stage inline and refreshes after changes.
checks: Place the component on the account page
Load an account with no opportunities

days.topic: Lightning Web Components: Communication, Navigation and Testing
days.lab_task: Build two components that talk through Lightning Message Service, navigate to records, show toasts on errors and test them with Jest.
checks: Select a record in one component

days.lab_task: Expose an Apex REST service for enrolments, call it from Postman with OAuth, and make a callout to an external payment API through a named credential.
days.deliverable: REST service, connected app and callout code

days.topic: Platform Events and Change Data Capture
subtopics: Subscribing with triggers, Flow and external clients
days.lab_task: Publish an order-placed platform event from Flow, subscribe in Apex and from an external client, and stream account changes with Change Data Capture.
checks: Subscriber catches up from a replay ID

days.topic: Security in Depth for Admins and Developers
subtopics: Sharing in Apex: with sharing and without sharing
Field-level and object security in code
days.lab_task: Fix an Apex class that leaks records by running without sharing, enforce field-level security in code, add Apex managed sharing and raise the Health Check score.
days.deliverable: Fixed code, sharing code and Health Check report
checks: Run the class as a restricted user
Read a hidden field through Apex

days.lab_task: Move the course project into a Git repository with Salesforce DX, develop in a scratch org, package it as an unlocked package and promote changes with DevOps Center.
checks: Create a scratch org from the project
Install the unlocked package in a sandbox
Promote a change in DevOps Center

days.topic: Data Quality and Large Data Imports
days.lab_task: Load 500,000 records with Bulk API 2.0, find and merge duplicates, avoid ownership skew and build a data quality dashboard.
days.deliverable: Load results, duplicate clean-up and dashboard
checks: Completes with errors reported per row

days.topic: Service Cloud in Depth: Omni-Channel and Messaging
days.lab_task: Set up Omni-Channel skills-based routing across email, web chat and WhatsApp messaging, add macros and build a service analytics dashboard.
checks: Routed to an agent with the Hindi skill

days.topic: Experience Cloud for Partners and Customers
days.lab_task: Build a partner portal where partners register leads and see their deals, using sharing sets, a custom LWC and self-registration.
checks: Sees only partner A's leads and deals
New partner user created with the right profile

days.lab_task: Configure a product bundle with options, a volume discount schedule, a price rule and a quote template, and generate a quote PDF.
checks: Build a quote with the bundle

days.topic: Marketing on Salesforce: Account Engagement and Marketing Cloud
subtopics: Syncing leads and contacts with Sales Cloud
tools: Account Engagement or Marketing Cloud trial
days.lab_task: Set up a campaign with lead scoring, an email nurture journey and consent handling, sync qualified leads to sales and report campaign influence on pipeline.
days.deliverable: Campaign set-up, journey and influence report
checks: Score a lead past the threshold
objectives: Connect marketing and sales on Salesforce

subtopics: Using flows and Apex as agent actions
days.lab_task: Build an Agentforce service agent with a topic for order status that calls a flow action, ground a prompt in case data, test it with 20 utterances and review guardrails.
days.deliverable: Agent configuration, prompt templates and test results
checks: Agent calls the flow and answers correctly

days.lab_task: Take a timed Platform Developer I practice exam, review wrong answers with Trailhead and plan final study.
days.deliverable: Practice score, review notes and study plan

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Custom Sales and Service Application
tools: Salesforce Developer Edition or scratch orgs
days.lab_task: Build a custom application with flows, bulkified Apex and tests, LWCs, a REST integration, platform events, an Agentforce action and source-driven deployment, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, package, test results and a 15-minute demo
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one application

advanced.summary: For senior developers, technical architects and Salesforce leads. Covers architecture at enterprise scale, large data volumes, integration architecture with MuleSoft, security and identity architecture, multi-org strategy, advanced Apex and LWC design, DevOps and release management, Data Cloud, Agentforce at scale, performance, governance, technical debt and architect certification preparation.
prerequisites: Builds Apex, LWC and integrations professionally
Holds Platform Developer I or equivalent experience
Has led or worked on a Salesforce implementation
outcomes: Architect Salesforce solutions for large enterprises
Design integrations, security and data at scale
Lead AI and Data Cloud initiatives and prepare for architect certifications

days.lab_task: Design the Salesforce solution for a bank's sales and service operations with org design, data model, automation, integration and security, and defend it in a design review.

subtopics: Data skew: ownership, lookup and account
days.lab_task: Diagnose slow list views and reports on 10 million records, make queries selective with indexes, fix account skew and archive old cases to Big Objects.
checks: Moved to Big Objects and still queryable

subtopics: Integration patterns: request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, UI update
Choosing APIs: REST, SOAP, Bulk, Pub/Sub
days.lab_task: Design integrations between Salesforce, an ERP and a data warehouse with API-led connectivity, build one MuleSoft flow that syncs orders with retries and monitor it.
days.deliverable: Integration design, MuleSoft flow and monitoring
checks: Pattern chosen for each integration with reasons

subtopics: Single sign-on with SAML and OpenID Connect
days.lab_task: Set up SSO with Entra ID or Okta and just-in-time provisioning, enforce MFA, configure customer social login for a site and pick the right OAuth flow for three integrations.
days.deliverable: Identity configuration and OAuth flow decisions
checks: Log in through SSO for a new user
User created with the right profile
Log in to the site with Google

subtopics: Compliance needs: DPDP Act, GDPR, RBI
days.lab_task: Design encryption for sensitive fields, set up a transaction security policy that blocks large report exports, analyse event logs and document compliance controls.
days.deliverable: Security design, policies and compliance record
checks: Each requirement mapped to a control

subtopics: Salesforce to Salesforce and integration options
Shared data and identity across orgs
days.lab_task: Assess a company with four orgs, recommend consolidation or multi-org with reasons, and plan the data, security and automation migration for the chosen path.
checks: Each org's purpose, data and users described
Supported by business and technical reasons
Data, users and automation covered with sequence

subtopics: Separation of concerns: service, domain and selector layers
days.lab_task: Refactor trigger logic into service, domain and selector layers with a unit of work, move settings to custom metadata, add a logging framework and cache a lookup.
days.deliverable: Refactored code, tests and logging evidence
checks: Change a setting in custom metadata

days.topic: Advanced Lightning Web Components and UI Architecture
subtopics: State management with Lightning Message Service and stores
LWC in Experience Cloud and mobile
days.lab_task: Build a component library with a shared state module, a virtualised custom data table for 5,000 rows and lazy-loaded tabs, and run accessibility checks.
days.deliverable: Component library, tests and performance results
checks: Tab code loaded only when opened

days.topic: DevOps and Release Management at Scale
subtopics: CI/CD with GitHub Actions or Copado
Static analysis with Salesforce Code Analyzer
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that validates, runs Code Analyzer and tests, deploys to QA and UAT and promotes to production with approval, then measure DORA metrics.
checks: Push code with a Code Analyzer violation
Lead time and change failure rate calculated

subtopics: Data Cloud in Flow and Agentforce
days.lab_task: Ingest CRM and web data into Data Cloud, harmonise it, resolve identities, build a calculated insight for lifetime value and activate a segment to marketing.
days.deliverable: Data Cloud configuration, unified profiles and segment
checks: Duplicate people merged into unified profiles
Insight values correct for sample customers

subtopics: Topics, actions and instructions at scale
Grounding with Data Cloud and knowledge
days.lab_task: Design and build a sales agent and a service agent with grounded actions, run 50 tests in Testing Center, set hand-off rules and build an adoption dashboard.
checks: Pass rate recorded with failures explained
Ask for an action the agent may not take
Agent hands over to a person

days.topic: Analytics with CRM Analytics and Tableau
subtopics: Choosing reports, CRM Analytics or Tableau
days.lab_task: Build a CRM Analytics dashboard for pipeline trends with a recipe, embed it on the account page, and create a Tableau view of the same data for comparison.

days.topic: Governance, Centre of Excellence and Org Health
subtopics: Org health checks: Optimizer and field usage
days.lab_task: Run an org health assessment with Optimizer and field usage analysis, build a technical debt backlog, write standards and set up a design authority process.
days.deliverable: Health assessment, debt backlog, standards and process
checks: Fields with low use listed for clean-up

subtopics: UI test automation with Provar or Playwright
days.lab_task: Write a test strategy for a Salesforce programme, automate three UI journeys, seed test data automatically and run regression against a preview sandbox for the next release.
days.deliverable: Test strategy, automated tests and regression results
checks: Run regression on the preview sandbox
Issues from the next release found or none reported

days.topic: Migration to Salesforce from Legacy CRM
days.lab_task: Plan the migration from a legacy CRM with 2 million records, map and clean data, run a mock migration, reconcile it and write a cut-over plan.
days.deliverable: Mapping, mock migration results, reconciliation and cut-over plan
checks: Counts match the source by object

days.topic: Industry Clouds: Financial Services and Health
days.lab_task: Configure Financial Services Cloud households and financial accounts for a bank scenario, compare with building the model on Sales Cloud and list compliance controls.

subtopics: Working with business analysts and admins
days.lab_task: Estimate a provided backlog of 30 Salesforce stories, review a pull request and a flow design, and write a status update for executives.
days.deliverable: Estimates, review comments and status update

subtopics: Application Architect and System Architect paths
Data architecture and management designer topics
Identity and access management designer topics
days.lab_task: Solve a timed architect scenario, present the solution to a mock review board and plan study for the designer exams.
days.deliverable: Scenario solution, board feedback and study plan

days.lab_task: Resolve four injected issues (a governor limit failure in bulk loads, a flow and trigger conflict, a record lock error and a failed integration), find root causes and write runbooks.
checks: Write a runbook for integration failures

subtopics: Data model at scale and Data Cloud
days.lab_task: Design and prototype an enterprise Salesforce architecture with org strategy, scaled data model, MuleSoft integrations, SSO, Shield, a DevOps pipeline, Data Cloud profiles and an Agentforce agent, then defend it to a mock review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, prototype, pipeline and a 20-minute review board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one architecture
Prove key parts with a prototype
Defend decisions to a review board
